name: Provenance and License Completeness
summary: Verify that a dataset has complete provenance metadata including source, license, hash manifest, and creation date
purpose: Verify that a dataset has complete provenance metadata including source, license, hash manifest, and creation date. Flag any missing or mismatched provenance fields.
assignment_instructions: You are auditing dataset provenance and license completeness. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_provenance_completeness_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - provenance_completeness_rate (number between 0 and 1): present_required_fields / total_required_fields - source_present (boolean): whether source field is present and non-empty - source_value (string or null): the actual source value - license_present (boolean): whether license field is present and non-empty - license_value (string or null): the actual license value - license_osi_approved (boolean or null): whether license is OSI-approved open source - hash_manifest_present (boolean): whether hash manifest is present - hash_manifest_match (boolean or null): whether computed hash matches declared hash (null if cannot verify) - creation_date_present (boolean): whether creation_date field is present and non-empty - creation_date_value (string or null): the actual creation date - missing_provenance_fields (list of strings): required fields that are missing Each of the 5 required fields (source, license, hash_manifest, creation_date, data_quality_statement) must be checked. Return provenance_completeness_rate as a number. List every missing field. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
